messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Detected sustained packet loss and BGP flap on customer AcmePay VPN to asia-east1 (tunnel-primary). Loss >25% for last 3m, repeated session resets.

Alex G: paging oncall — looks customer-impacting for AcmePay. App team reporting intermittent API timeouts from APAC.

Sara Y: I'm on it. Observed BGP state churn: ESTABLISHED -> IDLE -> ESTABLISHED on the primary peer. High retransmits on the tunnel.

Mike L: tagging @GCP-PS and @Nisha P — can you validate if asia-east1-a egress has issues? Packet loss appears to originate at provider egress.

GCP-PS: opened ticket with infra in asia-east1-a. We're seeing elevated tail drops on a subset of router blades and partial route withdrawals. Investigating fabric saturation vs. control-plane bug.

Nisha P: AcmePay uses two VPN tunnels: primary -> asia-east1-a, secondary -> asia-east1-b. Customer requested we shift traffic to secondary while infra investigates. Can we do an emergency failover?

Alex G: proposed plan:
1) prepare route preference change to favor secondary
2) withdraw/stop-announcing prefixes on primary
3) monitor application and BGP stability

Customer Support: AcmePay SRE confirms ~15% 5xx on payment endpoints over last 12m. They've approved temporary traffic shift to secondary.

Sara Y: running quick traces. Primary traceroute shows wide variance:
```
traceroute to 10.0.0.1
 1  10.128.0.1  1.1 ms
 2  provider-egress  35 ms  120 ms  30 ms  <- flapping
 3  10.0.0.1  31 ms  129 ms  29 ms
```
Secondary via asia-east1-b looks stable:
```
...  28 ms 27 ms 28 ms
```

Mike L: I have the runbook. I'll withdraw primary announcements from rdw-edge-1. Steps: withdraw prefix, wait 30s, confirm RIB updates, ensure secondary is carrying traffic.

Sara Y: commands to run on edge:
```
bgp withdraw 203.0.113.0/24 from-peer 192.0.2.5
show bgp neighbors 192.0.2.5 json
```

Mike L: executing now. Withdrawing primary routes. Will log action.

incident-bot: ACTION LOGGED: route-withdraw initiated by Mike L at 1871009900

Mike L: withdraw completed. Primary routes absent from RIB. Traffic observed shifting to secondary. Monitoring metrics.

Alex G: app metrics show 5xxs falling from 15% -> 3% within 60s. Good immediate effect. Keep monitoring BGP for continued flaps.

GCP-PS: infra reports mis-programmed ACL on some egress blades in asia-east1-a causing asymmetric drops. Patch deployed, rolling fix, ETA ~15m.

Nisha P: updated AcmePay SRE — they see improved connectivity and will keep sessions on secondary until provider confirms fix. They requested a post-incident summary.

Sara Y: collecting BGP debug logs for postmortem. Observed notifications:
```
BGP NOTIF: hold timer expired
BGP NOTIF: neighbor reset by remote
```

Mike L: set temporary policy to prevent auto-failback. Added tag `no-auto-failback` to route-policy. If primary recovers and flaps recur, manual intervention only.

Oncall (KYLE): I'm taking next 30m handoff. Summary: primary had asymmetric drops -> traffic shifted to secondary; provider applying fix; customer impacted but significantly mitigated. Next steps: 1) confirm provider fix 2) coordinate controlled failback per customer 3) produce incident write-up.

Megan S: I'll start the incident doc with timeline and attach traceroutes + bgp logs. Mike/Alex, paste any additional logs or exact prefixes you want included.

Mike L: prefixes: 203.0.113.0/24, 203.0.114.0/24. Acme ASN 64521. Primary peer 192.0.2.5 (asia-east1-a). Secondary peer 192.0.2.9 (asia-east1-b).

GCP-PS: fix completed and verified. No packet drops observed on primary for last 2m.

Nisha P: per customer request, we'll keep secondary active-standby for 24h. Do not failback automatically.

Alex G: agreed. We'll close after 1h stable BGP and customer confirmation. Planned controlled failback tomorrow 04:00 UTC if provider confirms clean.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigated — traffic shifted to secondary. Awaiting provider confirmation for resolution.

Oncall (KYLE): ack. I'll monitor and close after stability window. Final RCA will be assigned P0 for follow-up.

Megan S: saved initial PM and timeline. Will update with full RCA later.

Alex G: thanks team. Good coordination.
